name: solaros
description: SolarOS ERP — Enterprise Solar EPC SaaS Platform

scripts.build: tsc -p packages/types/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/contracts/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/config/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/ui/tsconfig.json && tsc -p database/tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && (cd apps/web && ./node_modules/.bin/next build)
scripts.check-types: tsc -p packages/types/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/contracts/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/config/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/ui/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p database/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit
